 This Petition Coming On For Orders This Day, The
Court Made The Following:-
 Order

Learned Sr. Panel Counsel appearing for the KIADB submits and this Court agrees that the petitioner does not have locus standi to lay a challenge to the acquisition as such, he having bought the subject land post Preliminary Notification.
However, Petitioner will not have any right to challenge the acquisition, as such need not be stated in so many words.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner having argued the matter for some time now submits that the award having been passed, liberty may be reserved to his clients to lay a challenge thereto or to seek enhancement of the compensation in accordance with law and matter be accordingly disposed off.
In view of the above, this writ petition is disposed off reserving liberty to the petitioner to lay a challenge to the award or for seeking enhancement of the compensation.
